title: REST, MCP, CLI and console
narrative: As a reqforge maintainer, I want rest, mcp, cli and console so that the documented requirements hold.

evals.name: interface tests
evals.command: cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test integration -- rest_api mcp_protocol cli console security_guard token_protects

evals.name: code-trace interfaces
evals.command: cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test codetrace -- http_routes cli_scan

evals.name: security headers and origin checks
evals.command: cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test integration -- security_guard token_protects
